The '''Manarai''', also called '''Menarai'''<ref name="Secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>, was an upscale [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located in [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] in the [[Manarai Mountains]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The restaurant was built atop a spire, in view of the mountains' highest peak, [[Umate/Legends|Umate]]. 

A gathering place for the planet's elite, one had to be approved by the management to book a reservation (months earlier). The exquisite experience of dining in the Manarai costed a fortune.<ref name="SES" />

==Layout==
The restaurant had [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] walls, offering a view to the Monument Park as well as Umate, among the Coruscanti skyline. The tiered levels layout ensured that the view was visible to all diners, contributing to its majestic ambience <ref name="SES" />

The layout of the restaurant allowed privacy among the diners, and its interior was decorated in a conservative way.<ref name="SES" />

On the top was a tower with platforms, where [[freighter/Legends|freighters]] arriving from all around the galaxy docked, and unloaded exotic creatures, plants and supplies that provided the foodstuff for its cuisine.<ref name="SES" />
==Management and staff==
The owners of Manarai kept a low profile and tight operation. It was speculated that a [[Unidentified Hutt clan lord|Hutt clan lord]], a [[Unidentified coalition of Core World Moffs|coalition of Core World Moffs]], and an [[Unidentified Imperial Advisor (Manarai)|Imperial Advisor]] shared stake in the Manarai. The management ensured that the restaurant itself remained the focus of publicity.<ref name="SES" /> Being a co-owner with [[Guri]], the [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] was allowed in any time he wished and had a specific table reserved.<ref name="Secrets" /> 

The quality level of the staff of the restaurant mirrored that of its patrons. Specialized scouts, pioneers of new cusinine, sought and recruited new chefs from all around [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Waiters were trained in protocol by experts.<ref name="SES" />

Specialized security staff monitored the background of its clientele, and whether they would bring trouble to the restaurant should any scandals or enemies would catch up with them. The management had to approve bookings; patrons who violated the establishment's standards were rarely permitted to return. Even the waiters were screened by [[Manarai security consultant|a security consultant]].<ref name="SES" />

Specialized [[Harvester/Legends|harvesters]] worked for the restaurant, bringing fresh products from the galaxy, while [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] and trappers were hired to catch big game and other creatures, sourcing the finest ingredients from across the Empire and beyond.<ref name="SES" />
==History==
Sometime during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Date" /> the Manarai was considered Coruscant's most exclusive restaurant, serving the planet's elite.<ref name="SES" /> The [[Master Chef]] of this restaurant was [[Tavvar Va'ran]], recognized as the second best [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="meal">{{WEGCite|story=A Very Special Meal|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

Xizor was visiting the restaurant three to four times per month, enjoying [[Moonglow]] at his specific table (anyone eating at, or who had reservations at that table at the times that he visited were forced to automatically give it up).<ref name="soten">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

One of its clients was [[Wendell_Wright-Sims]].<ref name="SES" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Prince Xizor secretly arranged to have the meddlesome [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the Manarai, and Va'ran added a dose of [[thetametabuterin]] to his [[Wroonian flycatcher filet]]. This recipe later produced an uncontrollable fit in Koozar, who died soon after.<ref name="meal" />

Some time before [[Battle over Coruscant|his death]], Xizor visited the Manarai for a last date with a certain woman, announcing their separation.<ref name="soten" /><ref>{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Xizor Relishes the Good Life|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC013.jpg}}</ref>
==Sample menu==
The Manarai spared no expense in catering to the most discerning culinary tastes, no matter how elaborate or esoteric. Signature dishes included:<ref name="SES" />
*[[Fleek eel/Legends|Fleek eel]] broiled in [[Zaffa oil/Legends|zaffa oil]]
*Stuffed [[Yam/Legends|yams]]
*[[Plicto steak]]
*[[Giant Ithorian snail]] in [[flounut]] butter
*[[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[land shrimp]]
*[[Wroonian flycatcher filet]]
*[[Sufar greens]] topped with [[mecolar briddlings]] and [[drezzle sauce]]
*[[Moonglow]]<ref name="Secrets" />
